title: ENHANCING VALUE ALIGNMENT OF LLMS WITH MULTI-AGENT SYSTEM AND COMBINATORIAL FUSION
reasoning: The paper focuses on value alignment in LLMs by instantiating multiple 'moral agents' (representing Authority, Care, Fairness, Loyalty, and Sanctity) and utilizes the Moral Integrity Corpus (MIC) to train and evaluate the system's ability to handle ethical pluralism and normative perspectives.
